column1: # Maithili word gold set (written 2026-11-14 before any Maithili tuning). Format: word, broad pronunciation(s) separated
# by |, category, source. W = WikiPron mai_deva_narrow (Wiktionary pronunciations, CC BY-SA 4.0; evaluation only;
# https://github.com/CUNY-CL/wikipron), converted: spaces and ᵊ removed, ɦ = h, t͡ɕ d͡ʑ = c ɟ, breves dropped; every
# Wiktionary variant accepted. F = word attested in FLORES-200 mai_Deva (CC BY-SA 4.0, evaluation only); L = Grierson,
# Linguistic Survey of India V.2 (1903, public domain), Maithili sketch; S = the example words of the project's language description. F/L/S
# pronunciations hand-written from Yadav 1996 (A Reference Grammar of Maithili) and Jha 1958: final short i/u written
# ि ु are said (also heard moved before the consonant: अछि əcʰɪ|əɪcʰ), ऐ औ = əi əu, avagraha = retained final ə/ɔ,
# ड़ ढ़ = ɽ ɽʰ, Hindi-type schwa deletion otherwise.
# Maithili sentence gold set: short sentences written for this set on the patterns of Yadav 1996 (A Reference Grammar
# of Maithili) and Grierson's LSI V.2 (1903, public domain), vocabulary attested in FLORES-200 mai_Deva (CC BY-SA 4.0);
# hand-written broad pronunciation (conventions as words.src; final i/u written in place). Written 2026-11-14 before
# any Maithili tuning. Format: sentence <TAB> pronunciation.
# Columns: id, kind, text, expected, category, source, split. Date of all items: 2026-11-14.
